source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban theory" AND (global OR south OR critique)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban theory" AND (global OR south OR critique),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban theory" AND ("critique" OR "global" OR "south"))
